newsitem.title: USA: Monarch Machine Q4 shr loss $1.25.
newsitem.headline: Monarch Machine Q4 shr loss $1.25.

text.p: (Dollars in thousands except per share data)
Gain on sale of foreign property 3,528 --

NOTES: Full company name is Monarch Machine Tool Co Monarch reported an after tax loss for 1996 of $764,000 or 20 cents per share prior to an after tax inventory write down of $4,734,000 or $1.27 per share. Included in this loss is an after tax gain of $1,940,000 or 52 cents per share resulting from sale of properties in the United Kingdom and Germany. The total after tax loss for the year 1996 was $5,498,000 or $1.47 per share.

Fourth quarter 1996 results, before inventory write downs, showed after tax earnings of $68,000 or 2 cents per share and an after tax loss of $4,676,000 or $1.25 per share after inventory write downs.
Fourth quarter sales were enhanced by a single large order shipped from the Stamco division, valued at about $6,400,000.
